column1: # The pictures in docs/games/LEVELS.html (docs/games/shots/<name>.png), each with the address it is taken from,
# at 1280 x 800, against a built page: `bun tools/pictures.ts http://localhost:5181 [name ...]` takes them again.

# A third column `wait` takes it with --wait=30000 (a page under ?debug&auto fetches its route after the load event; since order 35 the picture is taken as soon as the page says it has drawn, the wait the most it waits).
